build: Electronic Arts disk release, two double-sided disks as four G64 side images; play copies made with the game's own Copy utility

extra: tile set 6, unpacked from T35/L12 by enter_map ($2722) with map 12

comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 6, blank as in every set (13, 27, 32, 52 and 95 are blank too): the black surface of map 12's roads between their white edge lines, 337 squares, 11 of them class 10. Set 6 serves map 12 alone, 64 x 64 on side 3, whose texts include 'Entering the Vegas Hospital where the rich get well, and the poor die young.' and 'Entering the Las Vegas library.'; it draws 35 off its edge.

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature), none in map 12's layer. Computed from the records, its 18 encounter squares would show 1 (14 squares), 2 (2) or 4 (2); map 12 has no loot-bag square, so 5 is not drawn with this set as the map loads.

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure: with set 6 only game $AF1D-$AF25 draws it, on the party's square, because map 12 has it in its layer nowhere and has no class-4 squares. The self-modified operand of draw_tile's LDA at $2367 points here because tile 7 was drawn last.
Tile 8, the radiation sign draw_square shows on class-9 squares from 18:00 to 05:59 ($0B80-$0B8A): map 12 has no class-9 square and no 8 in its layer, so set 6's copy is not drawn as the map loads.

Tile 9 of set 6, white strokes with purple, red and blue, an arch over striped bars: the same bytes as set 0's tile 9, where the other seven sets have a purple peak. Game $AD13-$AD49 draws it on the square of each of the player's other parties on map 12; the layer does not hold it.

Tiles 10-13 of set 6: 10 and 11 round green bushes in two patterns (76 and 66 squares of map 12, in the blocks between its roads); 12 red, white and blue specks, in no layer but the tile of map 12's class-4 record 0 ($4E91), which a land-mine square (check record 1, $4D26, 38 squares) becomes once its mine has gone off (check records 6 and 7, $4D4D and $4D5A); 13 blank, unused.

Tiles 14 and 15 of set 6, white lines edged blue and green along a diagonal, green dashes on one side and black road on the other: 14 the south-west edge of map 12's roads that fall to the right (10 squares, x 28-61, y 0-10), 15 the south-east edge of those that rise to the right (47, x 0-45, y 0-49).
Tiles 16-18 of set 6, blue blocks with light blue and white edges, pieces of map 12's blue buildings (16: 4 squares, 17: 4, 18: 11), all class 11.

Tiles 19-21 of set 6: 19 a white flag on a blue pole over a green mound (10 squares in the green area at x 1-12, y 15-35 of map 12, above and beside its pond); 20 green tufts in rows (167 squares); 21 a two-armed green cactus (140 squares, 114 of them class 2).

Tiles 22 and 23 of set 6, blue water flecked white meeting green ground along a diagonal, at the top left (22) and the bottom right (23): the shores of map 12's pond, three squares each at x 1-5, y 31-37.

Tiles 24-27 of set 6: 24 grey and white rubble, an L of 11 class-11 squares at x 58-63, y 54-59 of map 12; 25 black with a small blue and white mark in its bottom left corner and 26 with a red and white one in its top right (16 and 15 class-1 squares where two road edges meet); 27 blank, unused.
Tiles 28 and 29 of set 6, set 3's purple blocks with black cracks, 28 edged light blue at its left and top: pieces of map 12's purple buildings (13 and 11 squares), class 11.

Tiles 30-36 of set 6: 30 and 31 the other edges of the diagonal roads, the north-west one of those rising to the right (48 squares, with red dashes in its top right cell) and the north-east one of those falling (9); 32 blank, unused; dashes on black, dense red 33 (40 squares), dense green 34 (155), sparse red 35 (184, also map 12's off-map tile) and sparse green 36 (113).
Tiles 37-40 of set 6, blue building pieces: 37-39 set 3's, edged light blue and white (14, 17 and 14 squares of map 12) and 40 a blue block crossed by black cracks (8 squares), all class 11.
Tiles 41-43 of set 6, set 3's purple blocks with light blue edges and black cracks: pieces of map 12's purple buildings (4, 12 and 6 squares), class 11.

Tiles 44-47 of set 6, set 3's white right-angle corners on black: on map 12 they draw the white outlines in the black lot at x 52-63, y 41-49 (44: 2, 45: 3, 46: 4, 47: 2 squares, three of them road corners elsewhere, at (41, 31), (41, 32) and (57, 27)).

Tiles 48-51 of set 6, blue water flecked white: 48 under a white top edge, 49 with a light blue left edge as well and 50 with the left edge alone, all three unused by the map; 51 open water, 8 class-1 squares of map 12's pond (x 1-4, y 32-37).

Tiles 52-60 of set 6: 52 blank, unused; 53-60 building edges with a gap, the entrances of the purple (53, 55, 57, 59) and blue (54, 56, 58, 60) buildings of map 12 (53: 9 squares, 54: 15, 55: 4, 56: 6, 57: 8, 58: 15, 59: 6, 60: 12), 69 of the 75 class 10, exits into other maps.
Tiles 61-64 of set 6, set 3's road edges: black with one white edge line, right (61: 128 squares), bottom (62: 314), left (63: 124) and top (64: 310), along map 12's straight roads.

Tiles 65-76 of set 6, purple blocks edged light blue and white, the corners and sides of map 12's purple buildings seen from above (65: 11, 66: 17, 67: 14, 68: 5, 69: 23, 70: 12, 71: 16, 72: 17, 73: 15, 74: 4, 75: 16, 76: 14 squares), all class 11; all but 71 have set 3's bitmaps.

Tiles 77-88 of set 6, the same pieces in blue for map 12's blue buildings (77: 15, 78: 22, 79: 20, 80: 24, 81: 17, 82: 34, 83: 9, 84: 18, 85: 29, 86: 25, 87: 29, 88: 41 squares), all class 11; 81, 83 and 84 have black cracks, and all but 77 are set 3's.

Tiles 89-95 of set 6: dashes on black, red 89 (66 squares) and 93 (125, sparser), green 90 (680, map 12's commonest tile) and 94 (182, sparser); solid fills 91 purple (16 class-11 squares inside the purple buildings) and 92 blue (42, inside the blue buildings and two in the pond); 95 blank, unused.

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 6 (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low nibble: pairs 10): the shared 0-8 ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76) and tile 9's $46, $26, $26, $26, the same four bytes as set 0's.

Colour bytes of tiles 10-36 in set 6: $56 (green, blue) for the bushes 10-11, the flags 19, the tufts 20, the cacti 21 and the diagonal edges 14, 15, 30 and 31, with $26 cells in 14 and 30; $26 for the specks 12, the marks 25-26, the red ground 33 and 35 and the blanks; $E6 (light blue, blue) for 16, 17 and the lower cells of 18; $56 and $26 for the shores 22-23; $CB for the rubble 24; $4E and $46 (purple with light blue or blue) for 28-29; $56 and $55 for the green ground 34, $55 for 36.

Colour bytes of tiles 37-64 in set 6: $E6 and $26 (light blue or red, over blue) for the blue blocks 37-40, the water 48-51 and the blue entrances 54, 56, 58 and 60; $4E and $46 (purple with light blue or blue) for 41-43 and the purple entrances 53, 55, 57 and 59, with a $2E cell in 55; $26 for the road corners 44-47, the edges 61-64 and the blank 52.
Colour bytes of tiles 65-88 in set 6: $4E and $46 for the purple walls 65-76, with $2E (red, light blue) cells in 65, 69, 70 and 71; $E6 and $26 for the blue walls 77-88.

Colour bytes of tiles 89-95 in set 6: $26 for the red dashes 89 and 93, the solid blue 92 (pairs 10) and the blank 95; $56 then three $55 for the green dashes 90 and 94; $46 for the solid purple 91 (pairs 01).
